ports.measure: turn records with a non-blank :source_text, of all turn records
turn records with a .analysis.json sidecar whose :sentences is non-empty; excludes analysis_status "declared" (bell turns get no 象 reading, turn_service.clj:1003-1006)
turn records with a :proposed_patterns key, of all turn records
turn records with a non-blank :reply_text, of all turn records
turn records with :happened_summary (the commit list after the trailer filter, turn_service.clj:976), of all turn records

operator-origin turn records whose :evidence_id is the turn-evidence-id of a ma-observation evidence row; excludes non-operator records (ma_observe.py:414 observes operator turns); agents absent from ma-enabled.txt are NOT excluded
turn records with a non-empty :pattern_verdicts (per proposed pattern: used / didn't-apply / missed); the field is not built yet
turn records with a non-empty :outcome_join (the next turn's id and its 象 tags as this turn's outcome); the field is not built yet
turn records with an e-xiang-turn-<id> row in the xiang-turn evidence query; excludes analysis_status "declared" and "not-requested" (not written by design, turn_service.clj:372-374)
turn records whose :reply_text has a line "㊢ (m40) used: ...", of all turn records
turn records whose :reply_text has the "㊢ (m40) used:" line with a "stored:" field, every stored slug existing as <memory-dir>/<slug>.md, of all turn records

turn records with a non-blank :reply_text in which every blank-line paragraph (fenced code removed) opens with a proforma mark; excludes records with no reply and bell records (origin "agent": bells are not marked, ~/code/CLAUDE.md:338)

turn records with any commit seen (a commit line in :happened_summary, turn_acts.clj:96, or a :commits_excluded entry); carrying when no excluded commit has reason no-trailers or trailers-unreadable (turn_service.clj:331-334)
